location.headline:
Unlock the
<gold>map.</gold>
location.bodyVenue: Partner venues and automatic check-ins — it all starts with where you are.
location.bodyGym: Partner gyms and automatic check-ins — it all starts with where you are.
location.offVenue: Location is off for POWR, so sessions at partner venues can’t be verified — and your phone won’t ask again. Turn it back on under {{path}}.
location.offGym: Location is off for POWR, so sessions at partner gyms can’t be verified — and your phone won’t ask again. Turn it back on under {{path}}.

preciseAlert.title: Turn on Precise location
preciseAlert.body: POWR verifies you’re really at a partner venue — approximate location can’t do that. Choose “Precise” so your sessions count.

precise.headline:
Close enough
to <gold>count.</gold>
precise.bodyGym: POWR checks you’re really at the gym, down to a few metres. Approximate location can’t do that, so sessions won’t count. Turn on Precise under {{path}}.
precise.bodyVenue: POWR checks you’re really at the partner venue, down to a few metres. Approximate location can’t do that, so sessions won’t count. Turn on Precise under {{path}}.

background.headline:
Earn while
you <gold>move.</gold>
background.body: No pressing start. POWR checks you in from your pocket — even when the app is closed. That only works on {{always}}.
background.offGym: Location is on, but only while you’re in the app — so every gym trip with POWR closed earns nothing. Set it to {{always}} under {{path}}.
background.offVenue: Location is on, but only while you’re in the app — so every partner venue trip with POWR closed earns nothing. Set it to {{always}} under {{path}}.

iosAlert.title: Enable "Always" for automatic check-ins
iosAlert.body: To detect arrivals at partner venues when POWR is closed, set location to "Always" in Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services › POWR.

locationOk.headline:
You’re all
<gold>set.</gold>
locationOk.bodyGym: POWR can see where you are and check you in automatically. Turn it off and you stop earning at geofenced venues and partner gyms.
locationOk.bodyVenue: POWR can see where you are and check you in automatically. Turn it off and you stop earning at partner venues.

battery.headline:
Don’t let Android
<gold>sleep on it.</gold>
battery.bodyGym: POWR keeps a light watch running so it can spot gym arrivals with the app closed. Battery optimisation kills that watch without telling you.
battery.bodyVenue: POWR keeps a light watch running so it can spot partner venue arrivals with the app closed. Battery optimisation kills that watch without telling you.

notifications.headline:
Know when
you <gold>earn.</gold>
notifications.body: A session lands, a streak’s at risk, a reward drops nearby — you’ll know the second it happens. Every alert is yours to switch off.
notifications.off: Alerts are off for POWR at the system level, so nothing below can reach you — and your phone won’t ask again. Turn them on under {{path}}.

session.title: Session recorded
session.body: 48 min at your gym — +50 POWR banked.

reward.title: Reward drop nearby
reward.body: A new reward just unlocked around the corner.

streak.title: Streak at risk
streak.body: One session today keeps your 6-day streak alive.

location.title: Allow “POWR” to use your location?
location.message: POWR uses your location to verify your sessions and surface rewards near you.

always.title: Allow “POWR” to also use your location even when you are not using the app?
always.message: Automatic check-ins only work with “Always” access.

notifications.title: “POWR” Would Like to Send You Notifications
notifications.message: Notifications may include alerts, sounds and icon badges.

location.title: Allow POWR to access this device’s location?

background.title: Location permission
background.whileUsing: Allow only while using the app

notifications.title: Allow POWR to send you notifications?

battery.title: Ignore battery optimisations?
battery.message: Let POWR always run in the background? This may use more battery.
